ID: `jado-design-systems`.

## What it does

Maps local tokens and components; applies stack-independent layout rules. Uses shadcn and Tailwind only in projects that adopt them, and better-layout when layout needs to be designed or corrected.

## When to use it

Use it when a solution affects shared components, requires a new variant or must be translated from canvas to existing tokens. If composing components without changing their contract is sufficient, the UI developer can act directly.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/jado-design-systems` in Claude Code or `$jado-design-systems` in Codex. Provide the approved result, components, tokens and editable files. Specify views consuming the component. Request a reuse map, reasons for exceptions and checks on affected surfaces.

## What it delivers

- Mapping from design to tokens/components
- Any authorized variants or tokens
- Exceptions and evidence from affected views

## Example

Map the approved canvas to design system components and add only the necessary density variant, in the assigned files.
